synopses.movie:191720: In 1974, filmmaker Alejandro Jodorowsky embarked on the quixotic project of adapting Frank Herbert's influential novel Dune for the big screen. The project failed, but its collaborators helped shape modern science-fiction cinema.
synopses.movie:531428: On an isolated island in Brittany at the end of the eighteenth century, a female painter is obliged to paint a wedding portrait of a young woman.
synopses.movie:660120: Four years in the life of Julie, a young woman navigating her love life and struggling to find her career path, lead her to take a realistic look at who she really is.
synopses.tv:1044: David Attenborough celebrates the astonishing variety of the natural world in this epic documentary series, filmed over four years across 64 countries.
synopses.tv:2316: The everyday lives of office employees in the Scranton, Pennsylvania branch of the fictional Dunder Mifflin Paper Company.
synopses.tv:2996: Nightmare boss. Tedious colleagues. Pointless tasks. Welcome to Wernham Hogg and the painfully familiar working life of David Brent.
synopses.tv:36536: Carmen, the daughter of a notorious Amsterdam drug lord, reluctantly takes charge of the family's smuggling business to clear her husband's debts.
synopses.tv:87108: The story of the catastrophic nuclear accident at Chernobyl and the brave people who sacrificed themselves to save Europe from unimaginable disaster.
